Kein Problem. Das Wissen rund um die bankspezifischen Systeme und Schnittstellen gibt das Team im Alltag weiter. Entwicklung: hohe Weiterbildungsbudgets, Coaching und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten im Haus. Extras: betriebliche Altersvorsorge, vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Mitarbeitendenrestaurant, JobRad, Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket und Angebote rund um Sport und Gesundheit. raw.title: Head of Finance (m/f/d)
raw.description:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

As we continue to grow, we are looking for a full-time Head of Finance to join us as soon as possible. In this role, you will take overall responsibility for the further development of our finance function in Germany and Europe and create the financial structures and decision-making foundations for L1VE’s next phase of growth.

Your Role

As Head of Finance, you will act as a strategic partner to our CFO in New York and the executive team. You will translate the overarching finance strategy into scalable finance, controlling and reporting structures, as well as robust planning and management models.

You will combine strategic foresight with strong execution skills: you will develop financial models and scenarios, evaluate business models, investments, partnerships and growth options, and make opportunities, risks and economic implications transparent to management.

In this role, you will work closely with the CFO, the executive team, functional departments and internal and external finance partners. A particular focus will be on international legal entity and intercompany structures, licensing and revenue-share models, as well as the further development of KPI, forecasting and reporting processes.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement L1VE’s finance architecture for Germany and Europe, with a focus on growth, profitability, transparency and international scalability
  • Own integrated financial planning, budgeting, business cases, financial models, forecasts and scenarios as a basis for strategic decision-making
  • Build and further develop relevant KPI systems for Technology, Commercial, Product, Marketing and Sales
  • Evaluate business models, investments, partnerships, licensing models and growth options, including their financial opportunities, risks and implications
  • Support financing rounds, investor readiness, due diligence and the preparation of strategic transactions in close coordination with the CFO
  • Manage and further develop management, investor and partner reporting based on reliable and auditable data and processes
  • Coordinate interfaces with Finance Administration, Accounting, Tax, Audit, Legal and other external finance partners
  • Further develop finance, reporting and governance structures, as well as the systems and processes supporting them

Your profile

  • At least seven years of relevant professional experience in finance, including several years in a strategically responsible finance role – ideally combining experience in a demanding consulting or Big Four environment with hands-on experience in a startup, scale-up or growth company
  • Experience building scalable finance structures and working with integrated financial planning, business planning, financial modelling, forecasting and management reporting
  • Strong knowledge of controlling, business performance management, governance, risk management and the evaluation of business models, investments and growth options
  • Understanding of German commercial, tax and corporate law requirements, as well as experience managing external professional advisors
  • Ideally, experience in the media, entertainment, sports rights, streaming, subscription or digital B2C environment, including licensing and revenue-share models
  • Experience with financing processes, investor reporting, due diligence or M&A is an advantage
  • Ability to structure complex financial topics clearly and act as a strategic sparring partner to the CFO, executive team and functional departments
  • Strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking, a high degree of independence and a strong sense of ownership
  • Confident and practical use of AI tools in finance; you can demonstrate with specific examples which AI-supported solutions you have implemented and what additional value they created
  • Excellent written and spoken German and English, as well as confident use of finance, reporting and collaboration tools

Why us?

  • You will shape the financial foundations of the next growth phase of an internationally active media and technology company.
  • You will work closely with our CFO in New York and the executive team and have a direct strategic influence.
  • You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build structures and systems that create lasting value.

Interested?

Please send us your CV along with a short cover letter or a few sentences outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Head of Finance role.
We look forward to hearing from you!

Contact person

Annette Hansen - Recruiting Manager

raw.title: Technical Cofounder / CTO | AI & ML PreSeed Startup
raw.description:
About us

Expertise is the bottleneck in technical field service. We are building the AI that makes it scale – and learns from every visit, from every job.

  • Stealth-mode AI venture building a copilot that guides technicians at every job like an experienced master craftsman – before, during and after every job

  • Built in the field, not behind closed doors: our product is developed with direct access to thousands of technicians with a leading European real estate industry partner – every feature is tested on real jobs, with results in days instead of months

  • Backed by Founders Factory; founding team in Berlin, MVP built and tested with technicians, now heading towards spin-out and first funding

  • Vision: Europe’s leading field service intelligence layer.

The role

We have built and tested our MVP. Now we are looking for a hands-on Co-Founder & CTO who builds the technology and product that grows and scales the company.

What you will do

  • Own the technology end to end: architecture, roadmap, build-vs-buy decisions, reliability and security

  • Take the tested MVP to a production-grade product used daily by technicians in the field

  • Build reliable AI workflows and repeatable integrations into customer systems such as work orders and asset data

  • Continuously improve the Machine Learning core: retrieval over manufacturer and expert knowledge, multimodal input (photo, voice) and diagnostic reasoning

  • Design and build the learning engine that makes the product smarter with every visit: capturing, reviewing, evaluating and reusing confirmed outcomes – the core of our knowledge moat

  • Set up evaluation, safety and monitoring: expert-reviewed benchmark cases, grounding, escalation and regression testing

  • Build a state-of-the-art UX/UI that technicians want to use every day

  • Spend time with technicians in the field and turn their feedback into product within days

  • Recruit and lead the engineering team as we scale

  • Shape the company as a co-founder: strategy, culture and investor conversations alongside the founding team

What you bring

  • Machine Learning experience, ideally 3+ years applying it in production products (e.g. LLMs, retrieval/RAG, NLP, computer vision, model evaluation)

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: you want to build a company, not just a product – full ownership, bias for action and comfort with ambiguity

  • Experience leading the technical build of a product from zero to one, e.g. as tech lead or founding engineer

  • Hands-on software engineering across backend, APIs, data pipelines and cloud – you still build and ship yourself

  • Sound technical judgement: you know the limits of LLMs, how to test them and when not to use them

  • Product empathy: you enjoy learning from users in the field and making complex work simple

  • Fluent German and English – German is needed for working with technicians and technical source material

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning/AI, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related quantitative field

Nice to have

  • PhD in Machine Learning, NLP, Computer Vision, Information Retrieval or a related field

  • Previous founder or early-stage startup experience

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure and enterprise B2B requirements (security, GDPR, multi-tenant SaaS)

  • Background in field service, industrial, maintenance or proptech software

  • Experience with multimodal AI, voice interfaces or decision-support systems

  • Experience hiring and leading engineering teams

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation package, including a meaningful co-founder equity stake

  • A true co-founder role with ownership of the technology and a real say in the direction of the company

  • An unfair head start: a cooperating partner with thousands of technicians and real repair data from day one – the fuel for a system that learns from every job

  • A tested MVP and a clear path to spin-out and funding

  • Support from Founders Factory’s network across tech, design and growth

  • A mission with real-world impact: helping close the skilled-trades gap in Europe

Location & start

  • Berlin / hybrid, flexible

  • Full-time; start as soon as possible

title: Art Director Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
description: Wir sind eine Performance Marketing Agentur mit einem großen Fokus auf Creative Design. Wir entwickeln datengetriebene Ad Creatives, Creative Strategien und skalierbare Produktionsprozesse für Social Ads, vor allem auf Meta und TikTok, und produzieren dabei über 1.000 Creatives im Monat. Kurz zur Einordnung, weil der Begriff Performance Creatives oft ein bisschen unklar ist: Damit meinen wir ganz einfach Werbeanzeigen für Social Media, also Bilder, Videos und UGC Ads für Instagram, Facebook und TikTok. Für YouTube erstellen wir die auch, unser größter Fokus liegt aber ganz klar auf Meta Ads (Instagram und Facebook) und TikTok Ads. Dabei arbeiten wir mit richtig großen Playern zusammen und begleiten sie strategisch, zum Beispiel Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli, Steiff, Gothaer, Finanzguru, Pixum und Olavson. Jetzt suchen wir einen Art Director in Vollzeit, der bei uns die kreative und strategische Leitung übernimmt. Das ist für uns eine extrem wichtige Rolle. Du entwickelst nicht einfach schöne Designs, du entwickelst Creative Strategien, die auf Research und Daten basieren, bist ganz nah an unseren Kunden dran, bereitest Reportings auf und leitest unser Design Team. Beim Thema AI sind wir extrem weit vorne. Unser Setup basiert auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield, nicht auf Adobe, und wir setzen einfach viel daran, jedem im Team richtig gute AI Prozesse an die Hand zu geben. Du kannst bei uns also super viel lernen. Wichtig ist nur, dass du in diesen Tools wirklich selbstständig arbeiten kannst. Genau deshalb arbeiten wir zielbasiert und nicht nach Zeit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns ganz normal, und wenn du es schaffst, deine Prozesse smart zu optimieren, hast du neben dem Job auch einfach ein richtig gutes Leben. Aufgaben Strategie: Du entwickelst Creative Strategien für unsere Kunden. Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du arbeitest die Strategie dahinter aus, inklusive Kampagnenkonzept, Angles, Testing Ansätzen und Messaging Research: Du tauchst richtig tief in Researches ein, also Zielgruppe, Wettbewerb und Plattformen. Welche Ads schalten die Wettbewerber, wie sind die aufgebaut und was funktioniert gerade auf Meta und TikTok Creative Deconstruction: Ads systematisch zerlegen und verstehen, welche Hooks funktionieren, was Aufmerksamkeit erzeugt und wie man die Zielgruppe bestmöglich abholt Reportings: Performance im Ads Manager analysieren, Learnings ableiten und daraus Creative Reportings und Strategy Präsentationen für unsere Kunden aufbereiten Kundenkontakt: Du bist regelmäßig im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, führst Calls, präsentierst Konzepte und Ergebnisse und bist kreative Ansprechperson Teamleitung: Du leitest unser Design Team (Grafikdesigner, Motion Designer, Video Editoren, Copywriter), briefst, gibst Feedback und entwickelst das Team weiter Kapazitäten: Du stimmst Kapazitäten, Prioritäten und Deadlines im Design Team ab und sorgst dafür, dass alle Projekte sauber laufen Qualitätssicherung aller Werbemittel, visuell und mit Blick auf Performance, inklusive Safe Zones und plattformgerechter Umsetzung Du entwickelst unsere AI Workflows mit Claude, Figma und Higgsfield ständig weiter und trägst Learnings ins Team Qualifikation Mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung (mindestens 3 Jahre) in Art Direction, Creative Strategy oder als Creative Lead, idealerweise im Performance Marketing oder Agenturumfeld Wirklich hohe Kreativität: Du entwickelst eigene, unverwechselbare Ideen, keine Copy Paste Ads Sicheres Auftreten: Du präsentierst Ideen klar und überzeugend vor Kunden und triffst im Team auch mal Entscheidungen Sicherer Umgang mit allen gängigen Designprogrammen, vor allem Figma Sehr gute AI Skills: Du nutzt Claude und Figma im Arbeitsalltag und arbeitest darin komplett selbstständig. Erfahrung mit Higgsfield, ElevenLabs und Co ist ein großes Plus Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Ad Creative Konzepten für Meta, TikTok o.ä. (PFLICHT, bitte im Portfolio zeigen) Du kannst mit Zahlen arbeiten: Ads Manager Daten lesen, CTR, Hook Rate, ROAS interpretieren und daraus Strategien ableiten Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein kreatives Team geleitet und Kapazitäten geplant Strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, auch wenn mehrere Kunden gleichzeitig laufen Du beschäftigst dich auch privat mit Social Ads, Trends und Plattform Updates Sprache: Deutsch mind. C1, Englisch mind. B2 Benefits Arbeite mit wirklich großen Marken wie Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli und Steiff, und zwar strategisch, nicht nur ausführend AI Vorsprung: Wir sind beim Thema AI extrem weit vorne, du lernst bei uns super viel und bekommst die passenden AI Prozesse an die Hand (Claude, Figma, Higgsfield) Zielbasiert statt nach Zeit: flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote first Datengetriebenes Umfeld, jede kreative Entscheidung wird messbar Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung Gestaltungsspielraum: Du formst die kreative Ausrichtung der Agentur mit Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft JobRad Mehrere Workations pro Jahr Regelmäßige Team Events Unser Prozess Weil die Rolle für uns so wichtig ist, gehören eine Testaufgabe und ein Interview fest zum Prozess dazu. Unser Setup basiert auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield, nicht auf Adobe, und wir setzen einfach viel daran, jedem im Team richtig gute AI Prozesse an die Hand zu geben. Du kannst bei uns also super viel lernen. Wichtig ist nur, dass du in diesen Tools wirklich selbstständig arbeiten kannst.

Genau deshalb arbeiten wir zielbasiert und nicht nach Zeit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns ganz normal, und wenn du es schaffst, deine Prozesse smart zu optimieren, hast du neben dem Job auch einfach ein richtig gutes Leben.

  • Strategie: Du entwickelst Creative Strategien für unsere Kunden. Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du arbeitest die Strategie dahinter aus, inklusive Kampagnenkonzept, Angles, Testing Ansätzen und Messaging

  • Research: Du tauchst richtig tief in Researches ein, also Zielgruppe, Wettbewerb und Plattformen. Welche Ads schalten die Wettbewerber, wie sind die aufgebaut und was funktioniert gerade auf Meta und TikTok

  • Creative Deconstruction: Ads systematisch zerlegen und verstehen, welche Hooks funktionieren, was Aufmerksamkeit erzeugt und wie man die Zielgruppe bestmöglich abholt

  • Teamleitung: Du leitest unser Design Team (Grafikdesigner, Motion Designer, Video Editoren, Copywriter), briefst, gibst Feedback und entwickelst das Team weiter

  • Kapazitäten: Du stimmst Kapazitäten, Prioritäten und Deadlines im Design Team ab und sorgst dafür, dass alle Projekte sauber laufen

  • Qualitätssicherung aller Werbemittel, visuell und mit Blick auf Performance, inklusive Safe Zones und plattformgerechter Umsetzung

  • Führungserfahrung: Du hast bereits ein kreatives Team geleitet und Kapazitäten geplant

description: We are Metrify Smart Metering , Germany’s largest competitive smart metering operator, and a new strategic spin-off initiative by Enpal. raw.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Design and build reliable, deterministic interfaces and drivers, from drafting the first interface control document (ICDs), to testing with state-of-the-art HITL simulators. 

  • Own the validation logic between the planning software and the hardware. 

  • Build diagnostics and secure software-update paths for deployed equipment. 

  • Build SITL emulators for the hardware you integrate, so the simulation team and CI can test against them. 

  • Lead the software side of qualification. Write the verification plan, build requirements traceability from requirement to test to result, and make sure every release ships with its test evidence and a controlled configuration.  

  • Own the software assurance pipeline in CI/CD: reproducible builds, secure boot and OS hardening, code signing, software bills of materials (SBOMs) and static analysis. 

  • Use AI coding agents as normal engineering tools: to draft tests, interface code and emulators, to check traceability links, and to prepare evidence. You decide where they are used and how their output is reviewed. Engineers own and sign the evidence. 


Who you are

  • A software engineer with 5+ years' experience integrating software with hardware in aerospace, defence, rail, automotive, medical or another regulated field. 

  • Strong modern C++. Rust is welcome. Python for test automation and tooling. 

  • Hands-on with hardware interfaces and protocols: Ethernet (UDP/TCP), serial, and fieldbuses such as CAN, plus time synchronisation (PTP, GNSS time). 

  • You have taken software through a formal verification or qualification campaign: requirements-based testing, traceability, and configuration and change control.  

  • Comfortable with HITL testing; debugging across the hardware/software boundary. 

  • Able to explain technical risk clearly to systems and safety engineers, and to customers and assessors. 

  • You use AI agents in your own work, and you have clear views on where they help and where they don't. 


What we offer
  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.

    Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.

title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
description: <p>Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning.&nbsp;</p> <p>Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.</p> <p>Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.</p> <h1>Your responsibilities will include:</h1> <ul> <li>Designing and building the ML/LLM LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.</li> <li>Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.</li> <li>Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications Your Role Focused Energy’s Software Department builds the internal applications, data workflows, system integrations and automation that help our scientists, finance, legal, people and executive teams work faster and more reliably. As a Software Engineer in our forward deployed model, you will join projects where Focused Energy has an important technical or operational need, understand the context, build and deliver a reliable solution, complete a clean handover, and then move on to the next priority. You will quickly learn several project domains across fusion systems, finance, legal and executive work, and you will own moderately complex features from design to deployment. You will be a go-to engineer for turning cross-functional needs into maintainable software, raising the standard for internal tools, and helping us reuse shared platforms and patterns. You will see your work directly shape how fusion research and company operations run. You will gain broad exposure to scientific, hardware, operational and business problems, and you will take ownership from day one. What You'll Do Own moderately complex, well-scoped features from technical design through testing, deployment and handover. Work directly with scientists, the people team, legal, operations, IT and other specialists to understand their goals and turn them into practical software. Build internal applications, data workflows, system integrations, APIs, automation and engineering tools based on each project’s needs. Add automated tests, logging, metrics, error handling and basic operational guidance to the software you deliver. Move between projects after delivering agreed outcomes, leaving software tested, documented, maintainable and ready for its long-term owner. Improve code quality, remove small areas of technical debt, contribute to code reviews, and reuse shared platforms and patterns where they fit. Learn several project domains quickly, deliver your first end-to-end features, and establish a reliable routine for testing, documentation and handover. Take on broader and less clearly defined projects, help standardize how internal software is built, secured and operated, and become a trusted partner for teams across the company. Who You Are You can independently own well-scoped work, with support available for broader architecture or highly unclear decisions. Strong software engineering fundamentals, including readable code, data structures, debugging, automated testing, version control and code review, with evidence of delivered working software. Ability to build and maintain software in a modern typed language such as TypeScript or JavaScript. Strong experience with a similar language is also relevant. Experience building web applications with a component-based frontend framework such as React, Vue or Angular. Understanding of relational databases and SQL, including schemas, migrations, permissions and data modeling. Experience integrating software through REST APIs, events, scheduled jobs or similar communication patterns. Understanding of authentication, authorization, role-based access and secure data handling. Familiarity with CI/CD, package management, basic infrastructure configuration and automated build, test and deployment workflows. Ability to use tests, logs, metrics and traces to find problems and confirm that software works as expected. Ability to use AI-assisted development tools responsibly for learning, prototyping, testing, documentation and delivery, reviewing output to the same quality and security standard as other work. Ability to learn new languages, frameworks, systems and technical domains, and a willingness to move between projects after completing agreed work. Ability to turn the needs of non-software specialists into clear technical requirements and to explain software decisions in simple language. Clear communication: you raise risks and blockers early, make realistic commitments, and take full ownership of handover, leaving no undocumented code. Understanding of maintainability, documentation, security, access control and operational readiness. Nice-to-haves Experience with TypeScript, React, SQL, PostgreSQL, serverless functions or Azure services. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, including serverless or managed application platforms. Experience working in a monorepo or with shared packages, reusable components and common engineering tooling. Experience with database security, row-level permissions, identity providers, single sign-on or role-based access control. Experience with infrastructure as code, CI/CD systems, cloud observability or secure secret management. Experience building internal tools, technical dashboards, data pipelines, search systems, automation or third-party service integrations. Experience working with scientists, hardware engineers, research teams, industrial systems or other technical domain experts. Experience supporting a project through handover, production use or transfer to a long-term owner. Familiarity with AI-assisted development workflows, used without lowering review, testing, security or maintainability standards. About ElevenLabs

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

 

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in the DACH region

  • Proven experience of owning and managing a defined Book of Business

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Proven experience working across the DACH market. Knowledge of the landscape and cultural nuances

  • Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents

  • Strong builder mindset - you thrive in ambiguity and being a pioneer, finding ways to innovate across a full region or market to drive revenue outcomes

  • Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs

  • Proven experience working cross functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams

  • Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities along with renewals

  • Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Germany.

title: Praktikum im Business Development - Prozessautomatisierung (m/w/d)
description: Bist Du bereit, den nächsten Schritt in Deiner Karriere zu machen und die Abläufe eines innovativen Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten? Bei Pflegia bieten wir Dir die Chance, im Business Development mitzuwirken und gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens zu gestalten. Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die Weiterentwicklung und das Wachstum von Pflegia vorantreibt. Dein Fokus liegt darauf, Prozesse zu verbessern, wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu automatisieren und Teams im Arbeitsalltag zu entlasten . Dabei übernimmst Du Verantwortung, bringst eigene Ideen ein und setzt Projekte selbstständig um. Wenn Du Dich in einem wachsenden Start-up ausprobieren und praktische Erfahrungen in der Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung sammeln möchtest, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Aufgaben Prozesse verstehen und verbessern: Du analysierst bestehende Arbeitsabläufe, erkennst wiederkehrende manuelle Aufgaben und identifizierst Potenziale zur Automatisierung. Automatisierungen umsetzen: Du entwickelst und implementierst automatisierte Workflows, beispielsweise mit No-Code-/Low-Code-Tools oder eigenen Skripten. Tools und Systeme verknüpfen: Du unterstützt dabei, Anwendungen über Schnittstellen miteinander zu verbinden und einen zuverlässigen Informationsfluss sicherzustellen. Lösungen testen und weiterentwickeln: Du überprüfst Automatisierungen auf ihre Funktion, behebst Fehler und passt sie an neue Anforderungen an. Teamübergreifend zusammenarbeiten: Du erfasst Anforderungen gemeinsam mit verschiedenen Teams, dokumentierst Deine Lösungen und unterstützt die Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei deren Nutzung. Qualifikation Du absolvierst ein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Informatik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich oder hast dieses bereits abgeschlossen. Du hast Freude daran, Abläufe zu hinterfragen , Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und praktische Lösungen für wiederkehrende Aufgaben zu entwickeln. Du bringst erste Erfahrungen mit Automatisierungstools wie Make, Zapier oder n8n oder Programmierkenntnisse , beispielsweise in Python oder JavaScript, mit. Du hast Interesse daran, Dich in neue Tools und Schnittstellen einzuarbeiten und Deine technischen Fähigkeiten auszubauen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und selbstständig , setzt Prioritäten und behältst auch bei mehreren Aufgaben den Überblick. Du hast Lust, in einem dynamischen Umfeld schnell Neues zu lernen und eigene Ideen einzubringen . Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau . Nice to Have: Du hast bereits mit APIs, Webhooks oder KI-gestützten Automatisierungen gearbeitet oder eigene kleine Automatisierungsprojekte umgesetzt. Benefits Modernes Office in Berlin – Mit bester Anbindung, freundlicher Atmosphäre und allem, was Du brauchst. Strukturiertes Onboarding – Du wirst intensiv eingearbeitet und jederzeit von einem motivierten Team unterstützt. Top Equipment – Laptop, Bildschirm, Headset – alles für Deinen Erfolg. Innovative Tools – Slack, Zoom & CRM-Systeme, die Deinen Arbeitsalltag effizient machen. Events & Teambuilding – Ob Fußball, Volleyball oder After-Work: Bei uns kommt der Spaß nicht zu kurz. Snacks & Drinks – Gratis Kaffee, Getränke, Obst und individuelle REWE-Snacks auf Knopfdruck. FRIYAY-Mood – Jeden Freitag gemeinsamer Ausklang mit Pizza und Bier. Office Dogs welcome – Dein Vierbeiner ist bei uns herzlich willkommen. Karrierechancen – Bei überzeugender Leistung ist eine Übernahme in eine Werkstudententätigkeit oder Festanstellung garantiert. Wenn Du Lust auf ein praxisnahes Praktikum mit echtem Impact hast, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Pflegia ist eine digitale Plattform zur Vermittlung von Pflegekräften in ganz Deutschland. title: Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d)
description: Are you fascinated by performance marketing and can't wait to open your laptop in the morning to see how your latest ad campaign is performing? Do you eat Lookalikes for breakfast and drink coffee with CPAs? Then keep reading! About REPLUG REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value, and long-term business growth. From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently, reduce dependency on saturated acquisition channels, and build sustainable growth. Our work combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution across App Store Optimization, Paid User Acquisition, CRM, measurement, and mobile growth consulting. REPLUG is looking for an experienced Mobile Paid User Acquisition Manager (m/f/d) , eager to take the next steps in their mobile marketing career working in a fast-growing international agency. You will have the opportunity to deepen your knowledge of mobile paid user acquisition, working alongside top industry specialists, launching, scaling, and optimizing mobile performance campaigns for our clients' portfolio, from subscription apps to mobile games. Your responsibilities Setting up and managing performance advertising campaigns on major Paid Social Media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snapchat, TikTok, etc.). Setting up and managing campaigns on Google Ads and Apple Search Ads Managing and analyzing campaigns on main Mobile DSPs (Applovin, Moloco, Mintegral, Kayzen, Unity, etc). Taking care of MMP (Mobile Measurement Partners) setup to ensure proper monitoring by our Mobile Paid User Acquisition team Creation and updating of performance reports based on targeted KPIs on tools such as Google Sheet, Google Data Studio, Tableau, etc. Continuous analysis and optimization of user acquisition and retargeting campaigns to achieve our clients' business goals. Prepare creative briefs for our graphics team so that we always have new creative for campaigns. Use UGC (user-generated content) tools to find the best creators to promote our clients' apps. Exploring artificial intelligence tools to improve our creative production process and our advertising activities in general Answer our clients' questions on campaigns, performance and setup independently, and explain why the numbers look the way they do. Take responsibility for your accounts' targets and KPIs, flag early when we're at risk of missing them, and come with concrete proposals for what to do about it. Consult with our clients on tracking & analytics topics such as SKAN, MMP, Attribution, etc. Requirements You have 3+ years of proven success in managing paid user acquisition channels for mobile applications You have in-depth knowledge of the main Mobile Measurement Partners tools (Adjust, Appsflyer, Branch, Kochava, etc.) and know all about tracking and attribution You know how to set up Apple's SKAd network You are familiar with Excel, Google Data Studio, Tableau or other BI tools You understand the importance of reporting, both to improve results and to show the client how good you are. You have good presentation skills and can use Google Slides, Keynote and Power Point You believe that small details can make a big difference You like to question every accomplishment to figure out how to improve. You keep track of your own open items, hit the deadlines you commit to, and raise it early when something is at risk, instead of waiting to be asked. You are proactive and bring an entrepreneurial mindset to the team You're a firm believer in sharing knowledge and eager to contribute to the community through content creation and speaking engagements You are fluent in English, but other languages are welcome. Plus: Basic understanding of app store optimization strategies. Plus: Use of tools such as Claude, Canva, Midjourney, CapCut is highly valued. At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics. There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA , Supacat , and Galvion , and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland. THE ROLE The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces. Your core responsibilities include: Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase. Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit. Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase. You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product. You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams. New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs. A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count. OUR EXPECTATIONS What we're looking for: A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk. At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts. Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly. Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software. You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces. Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial. Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then. It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level. You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English. DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED? Apply via the application form. title: Head of Applied AI
description: Head of Applied AI Location: Our offices are in Central London, along with several of our customers. Travel to our customer sites is required, the frequency of which will vary from customer-to-customer. You need to be able to travel onsite to London up to 3 days per week, although onsite requirements will vary week-to-week and customer-to-customer from 0 to 3 days. Defence/SC Clearance Requirements: SC clearance is required for our customer facing teams. You do not need active SC clearance as we will undertake checks upon you joining, but you must be eligible to pass SC clearance. DV clearance may be required for certain roles, so the ability/willingness to pass DV clearance is advantageous but not essential. About Cloudscaler Cloudscaler is a rapidly growing cloud consultancy. We partner with ambitious enterprise and public sector customers to design, build, operate, and support secure, governed cloud platforms that meet the highest regulatory and industry standards. We are scaling deliberately. Our revenue ambition depends on deploying the right people onto the right work quickly, and on making disciplined use of our capacity. This role is central to that. About the role Cloudscaler's Applied AI business unit launched at the start of 2026 and has grown quickly, with an established offering, live client engagements and a pipeline in place. The current Head of Applied AI is stepping back from the role for personal reasons and remains with the business to hand over, so the incoming Head inherits a running unit rather than a standing start. We are recruiting to take it into its next phase of growth. The work is running; the structure is not yet. Offerings are defined, collateral exists, engagements are live and Cloudscaler's public voice on applied AI is established. What does not yet exist is the shape around it: there is no ring-fenced team, no separate P&L and no formally defined roles. The unit began with strategy, technical expertise and sales all held in one place. Technical capability has grown since; strategy and commercial ownership have not. Formalising the practice - defining the team, the roles and the commercial structure - is part of the job rather than something the incoming Head inherits finished. This role has both external and internal responsibilities: Externally, it owns our AI go-to-market offerings and the customer, partner and pre-sales activity that turns them into pipeline, and it is Cloudscaler's public voice on applied AI. Internally, it carries full commercial accountability for the business unit, provides technical delivery oversight, builds and leads the practice, and is accountable for enabling the whole company to work with AI. The role reports to the CTO and works closely with leadership across the business. The person needs to be technical enough to direct and challenge the engineering work, and commercially credible enough to scale the unit and its offering. It is a hands-on role. In one week, you might write a business case for the Leadership Team, advise a client CTO on their AI strategy, review an engineer's architecture decision and speak at a conference on what we have learned. External responsibilities These responsibilities are customer-facing, partner-facing and public facing: Relentless client focus - Maintaining a relentless client focus, calibrated to how mature the business unit is, and being decisive about where to concentrate effort and what to stop. Early on that means client meetings and pipeline growth; later it means shifting weight to larger, more sustainable areas of demand. AI go-to-market offerings - Defining and owning our AI go-to-market offerings, working with sales to take them to market. For each offering, defining what it is, who buys it, the problem it solves, its indicative price and its delivery model, and reviewing the set as the market moves, retiring what no longer sells and evolving what does. Customer relationships - Building trusted-advisor relationships with our customers, from CTOs and CDOs to engineering leaders, advising at every level and translating the same insight into the right language for a C-suite sponsor setting strategy and for the developers implementing it. Converting those relationships into repeat work and referenceable engagements. Pre-sales leadership - Leading pre-sales activity on AI opportunities, from qualification through to proposal. Supporting the delivery and commercial teams on proposals, workshops and pitches, and leading on bids where applied AI credibility is the differentiator. Qualifying opportunities in or out, including declining those we should not pursue. Client collateral - Developing reusable client collateral (opportunity assessments, roadmaps and business cases) grounded in real delivery experience. Keeping it current as the offerings and the technology move and making it available to the delivery and commercial teams rather than rebuilt for each deal. Partner and industry relationships - Building and owning our AI partner and industry relationships (AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI and relevant industry bodies), including the technical relationship, joint go-to-market activity, and achieving and maintaining the respective AI partner competencies that matter to our customers. An existing network inside our partners is a significant advantage, as is fluency in how each organisation works, where it sits in the market and what it is seeking to achieve commercially. Deciding which competencies to pursue and in what order and keeping them current. Thought leadership and public voice - Providing thought leadership on applied AI and establishing Cloudscaler's public voice through speaking, meetups, blogs and whitepapers. Building our standing in external applied AI communities and contributing to industry discussion, with material grounded in work we have delivered. Market awareness - Tracking the AI market as it moves - model releases, tooling and emerging frameworks - and forming a clear view on what is credible, what is hype, and what Cloudscaler should adopt. Bringing that view to the Leadership Team early enough to act on it, and setting our position on what we adopt, what we monitor and what we set aside. Internal responsibilities These responsibilities cover the commercial, delivery and capability side of the business unit. Commercial accountability - Carrying full commercial accountability for the business unit, which is run as its own business and measured on clear financial metrics: pipeline, revenue and gross profit. In the first six months that means a six-month revenue plan, with forecast gross profit covering the cost of the leader within six months and the team gross profit positive within two quarters. This grows into full P&L ownership as the unit scales, including team economics that stand on their own. Reporting and investment cases - Reporting to the Leadership Team on monthly KPIs covering pipeline, utilisation and gross profit against the six-month plan, and building the investment cases that fund the unit's growth. Reporting runs from month one, including the business case for establishing a dedicated team. Technical delivery oversight - Providing technical delivery oversight of AI customer engagements, working with our delivery teams. This is an architect's role rather than an engineer's: technical enough to hold your own with client engineers and to delegate the detail, and disciplined enough not to commit to capabilities we cannot feasibly deliver. Reviewing architecture and design decisions and acting as the decision-maker when a technical call is needed. Building and leading the practice - Building and leading our AI practice: owning Cloudscaler's AI strategy and the roadmap to deliver it, hiring and line-managing the team as it grows, capability development, and a repeatable methodology and delivery standards that make quality consistent regardless of who is leading the engagement. Defining the capability model and establishing the practice as an internal centre of excellence for review and quality assurance as it grows. Decomposing and delegating ownership - Breaking broad areas of activity into distinct responsibilities that can be delegated and genuinely owned, and building the team to hold them. The scope of this role is deliberately broader than one person can carry: the expectation is that the Head of Applied AI grows a team around them - including the AI enablement hires already in train - and leads through that team rather than delivering everything personally. Internal AI usage guidance, reviewing internal projects, pre-sales attendance, marketing campaigns and enablement workshops each need a named owner; an informal approach works while the unit is small but will not scale. Accelerators and intellectual property - Building reusable AI accelerators and intellectual property that shorten and de-risk customer delivery. Registering the assets as the work matures - accelerators, frameworks and reference architectures - and working with engineering to keep them testable and current as models and tooling evolve. Treating them as Cloudscaler intellectual property with standalone value rather than delivery tools alone. Company-wide AI enablement - Enabling every Cloudscaler employee to work with AI, including defining our internal AI learning pathways. Setting the guidance for how AI is used in our own work and running the enablement activity that puts it into everyday use across the whole company rather than the practice alone. Internal community of practice - Growing an internal AI community of practice, giving colleagues outside the team a route to learn and contribute. Running it as a standing forum rather than ad-hoc sessions, so that colleagues outside the practice can build AI capability alongside their own work. Candidate profile This is a senior role combining technical depth with commercial ownership. We expect candidates to demonstrate the following: Technical depth in applied AI - Current, hands-on understanding of AI technologies, models and tooling, sufficient to direct development work, review architecture and design decisions, and hold credible technical conversations with client engineers and architects. Commercial track record - Experience owning a revenue or gross profit target, building the pipeline behind it, and reporting against a plan. Comfortable being measured on financial outcomes rather than activity. Consulting and client credibility - A strong communicator who can advise at C-suite level and at engineering level, and whom clients want in the room on their most significant decisions. Practice or capability building - Experience building a team or capability from a small base: hiring, setting delivery standards, and creating repeatable methodology rather than relying on individual heroics. Partner ecosystem experience - Familiarity with the AWS and Anthropic ecosystems, or a comparable hyperscaler and model-vendor landscape, including how partner competencies and joint go-to-market activity work in practice. External profile - A track record of public contribution on applied AI, or the clear appetite and ability to build one. Leadership and delegation - Experience leading and line-managing a technical team, including setting direction, delegating genuine ownership and developing people. Comfortable achieving outcomes through a team rather than personally delivering the work. Judgement and prioritisation - The ability to decide where to concentrate a small team's effort, and the discipline to stop work that is not producing. Benefits Discretionary bonus Discretionary security clearance bonus for those holding certain clearance Periodic offer of share options schemes 25 days’ annual leave 5 additional days per year towards training, certifications, or charity work Option to buy additional annual leave up to 5 days per year Public holidays opt-out scheme, the option to work on public holidays creating the flexibility to enjoy your time off when it suits you Certifications and training expensed Life Assurance Long Term Disability cover Employee Assist Programme for employee advice and support (including legal and counselling helpline) Health, Mental Health, Wellbeing, Financial and Legal support 24/7 GP access Pension auto-enrolment and contribution Employee referral scheme Client referral scheme Cycle to work scheme Travel expenses policy Interview Process Chat with Talent Team Remote interview with Hiring Manager Final in-person with Leadership Team Cloudscaler are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to equal opportunities regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ancestry, age, marital status, disability, parental status, religion or medical history. Reporting runs from month one, including the business case for establishing a dedicated team.

Technical delivery oversight - Providing technical delivery oversight of AI customer engagements, working with our delivery teams. This is an architect's role rather than an engineer's: technical enough to hold your own with client engineers and to delegate the detail, and disciplined enough not to commit to capabilities we cannot feasibly deliver. Reviewing architecture and design decisions and acting as the decision-maker when a technical call is needed.

Building and leading the practice - Building and leading our AI practice: owning Cloudscaler's AI strategy and the roadmap to deliver it, hiring and line-managing the team as it grows, capability development, and a repeatable methodology and delivery standards that make quality consistent regardless of who is leading the engagement. Defining the capability model and establishing the practice as an internal centre of excellence for review and quality assurance as it grows.

Decomposing and delegating ownership - Breaking broad areas of activity into distinct responsibilities that can be delegated and genuinely owned, and building the team to hold them. The scope of this role is deliberately broader than one person can carry: the expectation is that the Head of Applied AI grows a team around them - including the AI enablement hires already in train - and leads through that team rather than delivering everything personally. Internal AI usage guidance, reviewing internal projects, pre-sales attendance, marketing campaigns and enablement workshops each need a named owner; an informal approach works while the unit is small but will not scale.

Accelerators and intellectual property - Building reusable AI accelerators and intellectual property that shorten and de-risk customer delivery. Registering the assets as the work matures - accelerators, frameworks and reference architectures - and working with engineering to keep them testable and current as models and tooling evolve. Treating them as Cloudscaler intellectual property with standalone value rather than delivery tools alone.

Company-wide AI enablement - Enabling every Cloudscaler employee to work with AI, including defining our internal AI learning pathways. Setting the guidance for how AI is used in our own work and running the enablement activity that puts it into everyday use across the whole company rather than the practice alone.

Internal community of practice - Growing an internal AI community of practice, giving colleagues outside the team a route to learn and contribute. Running it as a standing forum rather than ad-hoc sessions, so that colleagues outside the practice can build AI capability alongside their own work.

Candidate profile

raw.title: Graduate Product Designer 2027 (London)
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the Role

There's a lot behind a morning coffee order. You could be part of it.

A local café, a courier on the way and a customer ready to start their day. At Deliveroo, we connect people with the food, shops and products they love.

As a Graduate Product Designer, you'll work at the intersection of data, design, and engineering, helping define how millions of people experience Deliveroo and turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. This is a full-time role based in our London HQ.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining one of our core teams: Consumer, Merchant, Dasher, Ads & Promos,  or Customer Experience & Integrity. You'll work on real projects that impact millions of customers, merchants, and Riders, collaborating with Product, Research, Data, and Engineering to prototype your concepts, test with real users, and ship improvements to millions of people. 

  • You'll learn from designers shaping this new practice - one where AI is native to how you explore ideas, prototype, and ship.
  • You'll grow faster than you thought possible - with a dedicated manager, a mentor, and a team invested in your development, you'll quickly grow to own design end-to-end.
  • You'll experiment with how AI can change the way you work and design processes, and ship polished features that reach millions of users, merchants, and Riders.
  • You'll use AI to explore divergent directions, build high-fidelity prototypes, and pressure-test ideas before they ship, leveraging this technology to help you shape how our product becomes smarter, more intuitive, and more human.
  • You'll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of our product and process. As part of an early class of new graduates, what you figure out won't just shape your own projects - it'll shape how design is practiced across the team.
  • You'll refine your craft with mentors and peers in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment that values curiosity, craft, and collaboration.
  • You'll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, PMs, and researchers to find the right problems to solve and ensure high-quality implementation.

What You'll Need to Thrive

We're looking for strong design foundations and curiosity to grow. Here's what you'll need to join us and thrive in the role:

  • You're in your final year of study, graduating with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in design or a technology-related field (e.g. Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Digital Design, Industrial Design, etc) and available to start full-time in 2027.
  • You have a portfolio (school, internships, or side projects) that shows strong design fundamentals - visual design, interaction design, and user-centered problem solving.
  • AI is already part of your process and your portfolio includes at least one case study showing how you applied AI in your design process or designed an AI-powered experience.
  • You communicate through prototypes - using Figma alongside AI-driven tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) to turn ideas into working experiences quickly.
  • You're excited to learn, comfortable making decisions or asking for help, and able to iterate quickly as you incorporate feedback.

Why Join Us? 

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters - solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. You'll be paired with a dedicated manager and a mentor while being supported by a community of designers passionate about learning and helping each other grow.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to: 


🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
      Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱See your impact, fast
     Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership
    environment.

🧠Grow through challenge and ownership
     Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎A culture built for builders
     High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Account Director - Enterprise Tech & Media
description: <div> <p><strong>Location</strong>: London, UK</p> <p><strong>Weekly office requirement:</strong> Minimum 2 days per week<br><strong>Employment type:</strong> permanent<br><br><br>At GWI we’re always looking for extraordinary people who thrive on making an extraordinary impact. Right now we’re looking for an Account Director to play a key role in our Enterprise Tech &amp; Media team in London. If that’s you, and making a difference gets you out of bed in the morning, keep reading. It could be the start of something, well, extraordinary.</p> <br> <h1>Sounds great, what will I be doing? 🤔</h1> <p>As an Account Director in the Enterprise Tech &amp; Media team, you’ll help support our global expansion, working across our most lucrative Tech clients, like Meta and Microsoft. GWI is the world's most revealing data set on consumer behaviors. We work with the world's largest Media Owners, Agencies and Brands to help drive smarter marketing decisions and generate revenue.</p> <br>A few things you’ll be responsible for:&nbsp;</div> <h3>👉 Work closely with your Senior Director Tech &amp; Media to intensify and expand your tech platform client relationships.</h3> <p>👉 Help to drive and execute the expansion strategy and grow assigned portfolio year-on-year; including building client mappings and ability to perform gap analysis</p> <p>👉 Negotiate with key stakeholders and regularly closing opportunities.</p> <p>👉 Regularly lead client conversations and detailed presentations face-to-face, via email, on the phone and via screen share.</p> <p>👉 Identify and engage with key target contacts via personal network, qualified in-bound leads and proactive outbound engagement with key DM’s in defined vertical against defined corporate targets</p> <p>👉 Project-manage and prepare client presentations by using GWI datasets and deliver tailored pitch and proposal documents</p> <p>👉 Diligent approach to tracking all conversations and managing all sales opportunities via Salesforce.</p> <p>👉 Stay up-to-date on key developments and changes within the GWI product eco-system; as well as have an acute awareness of wider developments in the digital and media advertising landscape.<br><br>It’s also fun; shaking things up is what working for GWI is all about. You’ll need to be flexible, comfortable with continuous change, and working in a high-tempo environment.</p> <h1>What do I need to bring with me? 🧳</h1> <p>You’ll need to be able to demonstrate the core skills this role requires. You don't have to tick all the boxes right away; the important thing is that you’re willing to learn. Here’s what the team will be looking for in you:</p> <p>👉 Proven Account Management experience working with top tier clients in the media, platform, advertising or research industry.</p> <p>👉 Commercial Tenacity &amp; Resilience: Unwavering determination and drive to consistently surpass client expectations and revenue goals, remaining composed, optimistic, and focused during high-stakes renewal and expansion negotiations.</p> <p>👉 Knowledge/network of clients of the media/advertising industry.</p> <p>👉 Detailed understanding of the SaaS revenue model and how to identify growth potentials</p> <p>👉 Great knowledge in consumer research and how current trends change their behavior.</p> <p>👉 Proven track of working in the research sector, including knowledge of quant and qual methodologies</p> <p>👉 Negotiate with key stakeholders and regularly closing opportunities.&nbsp; - a driver for this skill could be 'Relationship building'&nbsp;</p> <p>👉Excellent communication and influencing skills; able to build trust at C-level.</p> <p>👉Strategic thinker with commercial acumen and problem-solving skills.</p> <p><br>Why Join Us</p> <p>👉 Be part of something that matters. Join a disruptor shaping the global market research industry, where your work drives real impact</p> <p>👉 Think big, move fast. You'll be immersed in the fast-moving world of data tech, working on problems that actually challenge you</p> <p>👉 Collaboration at the core. Thrive in a forward-thinking team that values ambition, curiosity, and genuine respect for one another</p> <p>👉 A culture that trusts you. We're not afraid to ask why, and neither should you be. Entrepreneurial spirit is celebrated here</p> <h1>Diversity, Equity &amp; Inclusion 🫶</h1> <p>Diversity is fundamental to who we are—as a data company and as a workplace. Our data reflects global realities, and so must our teams. We strive to build a workforce as diverse and inclusive as the insights we deliver.</p> <p>As a Disability Confident employer, we welcome applications from disabled candidates and are committed to making adjustments throughout the hiring process—whether that's extra time, materials in advance or a different format, breaks, an adjusted interview format, assistive tools, or flexible scheduling. We're happy to discuss whatever would work best for you.</p> <p>We actively encourage applications from underrepresented and marginalised communities.</p> <p>At GWI, you'll find a place to contribute meaningfully, grow professionally, and belong fully.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/y97yWcrpLTE" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>#li-hybrid<br>#LI-VS01</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.</p></div><h3><strong>What is The Role</strong></h3> <p>The Chat team, part of Elastic’s Agents and Context group, builds the conversational and agentic platform that lets customers chat with and operate on their own data in Elasticsearch. We own the conversation experience, the agent harness and tools, retrieval and citations, streaming, memory, and the evaluation layer that keeps answers grounded and reliable. Everything we ship is production software that other Elastic solutions build on.</p> <p>As Senior Engineering Manager you will lead a distributed team of approximately 12 engineers building this platform. Every engineering team at Elastic is led by a trio of Product Manager, Technical Lead and Engineering Manager. You hold people accountable and navigate hard conversations without drama.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People</strong></h2> <p>As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. This role owns the full lifecycle of a defined segment of our training and consulting portfolio. You will be the bridge between our subject matter experts and the wider business – sales, marketing and delivery – making sure every product is high-quality, ISO-compliant and commercially sound.

Just as importantly, you will help make our portfolio more scalable, so that great products no longer depend on SMEs doing all of the development themselves.

  • Own the product lifecycle: take a defined set of training and consulting products through design, development, QA, release and maintenance, delivering against timelines, budgets, quality standards and commercial goals.

  • Identify learning needs: use training needs and gap analysis, customer insight and delivery feedback to shape new products and refresh and improve existing ones.

  • Shape new products: work with Business Development and SMEs to define market needs, build the case for new products and position them for sale.

  • Create high-quality materials: presentations, workbooks, facilitator guides, lesson plans, marketing collateral and digital content.

  • Champion quality: run QA, proofreading, brand, IP and publication checks before anything is released.

  • Keep products current: manage version control, maintenance cycles and product KPIs.

  • Improve the learner experience: raise the standard of design and usability across classroom, virtual and blended formats.

  • Work smarter with AI: use AI tools to speed up development and reduce SME drafting time.


What you will bring

  • At least 2 years’ experience in training product development, instructional or learning design, or L&D content development.

  • AI used effectively across the development process.

We work as one with our clients, sharing serious know-how, rigour and expertise. Redline Assured Security delivers government-standard aviation security, and Kenyon International delivers crisis management and response. Each brand keeps its own name, heritage and team. What we offer

  • Generous holiday allowance

  • Healthcare cover for everyone, including dental and optical

  • Support for personal career development

  • Flexible working arranged with your manager

raw.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

We're looking for an analytics engineer to contribute to the analytical foundation of the UK Cards team, a growing area of the business.

You’ll work closely with analysts, product teams, backend engineers, and business stakeholders to improve how data is structured, transformed, and consumed across the company.

The role is fundamentally about building a strong analytical foundation: making it easier for teams to move from question to insight quickly, while maintaining high standards around data quality, scalability, and maintainability.

You'll contribute to the modelling layer, help improve how the business work with data, and support the team in keeping our warehouse a reliable, strategic asset for the business.

What you'll be doing

  • Building and improving the data models that support lending decisions, pricing, portfolio analysis, and investor reporting.

  • Championing standards and contributing to the improvement of our analytics engineering culture.

  • Supporting and collaborating with analysts at different technical levels,helping translate requirements into robust pipelines

  • Helping triage and resolve issues that affect the analytics pipeline or reduce trust in downstream datasets, and contributing ideas to improve the efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of our transformation pipeline over time.

Our modern data stack

You’ll work with a modern analytics stack centred around SQL, Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran and Claude.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone with solid analytics engineering fundamentals and the ability to apply them pragmatically in a fast-moving environment and explain tradeoffs to stakeholders with varying technical depth.

  • Strong DBT and SQL is a must

  • Strong data modelling skills and a good understanding of how analytical datasets should be structured for reliability and usability.

  • Strong experience with ELT pipelines and transformation at scale, ideally using dbt.

  • Experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data warehouse.

  • Proactiveness in raising areas of data workflows that could be improved and suggesting solutions.

  • A collaborative working style and clear communication across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Comfort using AI tools effectively to move faster, improve quality, and strengthen day-to-day analytical and engineering workflows

Interview process

  1. 15 minute cognitive assessment

  2. Initial chat

  3. 30 minute chat with hiring manager

  4. 60 minute technical interview

  5. 60 minute culture interview

Please note that unfortunately we're unable to sponsor for this position

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations
