Région parisienne

Votre mission

Dans un environnement où la disponibilité et la fiabilité des infrastructures sont essentielles, Isatalent recherche un(e) Head of DC Operations pour piloter les opérations de ses data centers en région parisienne.

Rattaché(e) à la direction, vous êtes garant(e) de la performance opérationnelle, de la continuité de service et de la fiabilité des infrastructures. Vous encadrez les responsables de site et travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'expertise centrales, les clients et les partenaires de maintenance.

Dans un contexte de croissance de l'entreprise et d'exigences opérationnelles, vous jouez un rôle clé dans l'harmonisation des pratiques, la structuration du pilotage des activités et l'accompagnement du changement auprès des équipes.

Votre objectif : construire une vision opérationnelle consolidée, maîtriser les risques et fédérer les équipes autour d'exigences communes de performance, de sécurité et de qualité de service.

Vos responsabilités

Piloter la stratégie et la performance des opérations multisites

  • Élaborer une feuille de route opérationnelle à court et moyen terme, en définissant les priorités, les plans d'action et les ressources humaines et financières nécessaires.

  • Reprendre et consolider la cartographie des risques opérationnels et techniques, notamment les points uniques de défaillance (SPOF) et les obsolescences critiques.

  • Hiérarchiser les risques, définir les plans de traitement, en évaluer les impacts financiers et humains et identifier les investissements nécessaires.

  • Piloter les incidents majeurs, les escalades, les analyses de causes et le suivi des actions correctives et préventives.

  • Garantir le respect des exigences de sécurité, de conformité et de continuité de service.

Développer la relation client et le partenariat avec les mainteneurs

  • Garantir le respect des engagements contractuels, des SLA et des standards de qualité attendus par les clients.

  • Renforcer la qualité de la communication opérationnelle et la confiance avec les interlocuteurs clients.

  • Développer une relation constructive et partenariale avec les mainteneurs et les prestataires.

  • Améliorer la coordination des interventions, le suivi des engagements et la qualité des prestations.

  • Identifier les axes de progrès et piloter les actions d'amélioration de la performance des partenaires.

  • Élaborer et suivre les budgets OPEX et CAPEX du périmètre.

  • Déployer des standards, procédures et méthodes de travail homogènes.

  • Contribuer à l'amélioration de la performance énergétique des installations, notamment du PUE, et à la maîtrise des coûts d'exploitation.

Votre profil

Formation et expérience

  • Formation supérieure, idéalement Bac +5, de type ingénieur ou master spécialisé en génie électrique, énergétique, climatique, maintenance industrielle ou management des opérations. Un Bac +3 technique pourra être étudié au regard d'une expérience particulièrement solide.

  • Expérience significative dans l'exploitation, la maintenance ou la direction technique d'infrastructures critiques.

  • Expérience confirmée dans un environnement critique fonctionnant 24h/24 et 7j/7, avec de fortes exigences de disponibilité, de sécurité et de conformité.

  • Expérience en gestion d'incidents majeurs, pilotage de budgets, gestion des risques et conduite de transformations opérationnelles.

Compétences techniques

  • Bonne maîtrise des enjeux d'exploitation des data centers et compréhension des architectures électriques, mécaniques, CVC, de protection incendie, de GTB/BMS et des systèmes de contrôle.

Qualités personnelles

  • Leadership et capacité à manager des responsables expérimentés.

  • Crédibilité technique et sens des responsabilités.

  • Capacité à structurer une organisation, harmoniser les pratiques et conduire le changement.

  • Aptitude à fédérer les équipes et à développer la coopération transverse.

  • Capacité de décision, d'arbitrage et de priorisation.

  • Sang-froid en situation de crise, rigueur et orientation résultats.

  • Sens du client et capacité à construire des relations de partenariat durables.

Langues : français courant et anglais professionnel, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

Au cours des premiers mois, vous aurez notamment pour objectifs de construire une feuille de route opérationnelle claire, de consolider le pilotage par les indicateurs, de hiérarchiser les risques et de définir les moyens nécessaires à leur traitement.

raw.title: Insurance Compliance Counsel
raw.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The Role

Alan’s Insurance Compliance Counsel, you will be Alan's expert on insurance compliance and consumer protection regulation. You will define how regulatory obligations translate into Alan's tools, processes, and products. You will own the compliance posture on your perimeter, proactively manage our exposure, and be the primary interface with regulators on the topics you cover.

You will also be a key connector between the compliance function, internal control, and the audit processes Alan conducts - ensuring audit findings are properly digested, remediated, and embedded into how we operate.

As Alan expands into new markets, you will play a central role in ensuring our compliance standards travel with us: adapting Group frameworks to local requirements and helping stand up the right compliance foundations in new geographies.

The role sits within the Legal Area in the Corporate Unit, and involves close daily collaboration with the Legal, Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care, and Product teams across all of Alan's markets.

 

What You Will Do

Own Alan's Insurance Compliance Posture

  • Define how regulatory obligations relating to Alan’s core product (IDD including duty of advice, product governance, AML/CFT, etc.) translate into Alan's operational processes, product design, and tooling

  • Suggest optimal ways to meet regulatory requirements within Alan's products while improving members' experience - from pricing components and options design to UX choices and complaint handling

  • Proactively identify compliance risks, assess their exposure, and develop mitigating action plans in coordination with internal stakeholders

  • Lead the structuring and continuous improvement of Alan's complaints management framework across France, Belgium, and Spain, ensuring compliance with ACPR recommendations and local equivalents

Reporting & Audits

  • Serve as the compliance function's key contributor to Alan's internal control system: document compliance-related risks and controls in the Group's centralised mapping, and co-deploy the internal control approach across teams (Insurance, Operations, Sales, Care)

  • Prepare and support internal and external audits: assess Alan's standing against planned operational improvements, define remediation plans, and drive and monitor their effective implementation

  • Report on compliance obligations and risk exposure to Alan's Board and governance committees, with clarity and foresight; Manage regulatory reporting obligations including the ACPR Questionnaire Protection de la Clientèle (QPC)

  • Respond to regulatory inspections (ACPR, FSMA, or equivalent in Alan’s operating countries), coordinating internally and ensuring Alan is always audit-ready

AML/CFT & KYC

  • Support the AML framework: conduct second-level analysis on suspicious cases, manage relationships with regulatory bodies and financial intelligence units, approve high-risk client relationships (including PEPs), and maintain the AML/CFT risk assessment framework

  • Oversee KYC Ops referents' training and upskilling, including Belgium-specific AML requirements

  • Coordinate with the AMLO on annual priorities, documentation, monitoring tools, and regulatory reporting to the ACPR and equivalent supervisors

Compliance Roadmap & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Maintain Alan's compliance roadmap: prioritise, track progress, update the risk mapping, and re-prioritise as the regulatory environment evolves

  • Lead compliance projects with internal stakeholders across Insurance, Product, Sales, Care, and Operations, translating regulatory requirements into concrete deliverables and timelines

  • Contribute to pragmatic compliance positions on regulatory requirements that affect our products and contracts - turning complex constraints into well-reasoned, pragmatic solutions that support the business.

Regulatory Training & Internal Capability

  • Design and maintain mandatory regulatory training programmes for Sales and Care roles (IDD competency requirements including duty of advice and product governance, Loi Evin, AML/CFT)

  • Build internal compliance frameworks, guidelines, and decision-making tools that increase team autonomy and reduce reliance on external resources

  • Contribute to Alan's written culture by producing high-quality documentation that teams can rely on independently

International Compliance & Localisation

  • Ensure Alan's compliance standards travel consistently across all Group markets, whether existing (France, Belgium, Spain, Canada) or newly opened, adapting Group frameworks to local regulatory requirements and deploying them locally in coordination with local counsel.

 

Profile

Experience & Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in compliance in an insurance or fintech company; solid coverage of at least two of the following: AML/CFT, insurance distribution (IDD), complaints handling, regulatory reporting

  • Solid understanding of the French insurance regulatory framework and ability to work across EU/local requirements

  • Proven ability to lead compliance projects cross-functionally: you translate regulatory requirements into clear priorities, align internal stakeholders, and deliver without creating bottlenecks or increased friction

  • Bilingual French/English (both required, written and spoken)

  • International exposure is a strong plus

You Will Thrive Here If You Are

  • A pragmatic problem-solver: you find the right answer within regulatory constraints rather than defaulting to the most conservative one

  • Rigorous and well-organised: you maintain high documentation standards, track your commitments, and keep stakeholders informed

  • Business-minded: you understand what matters for the company's growth and your members' protection, and you calibrate your compliance work accordingly

🎯 Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply, as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist. We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Combine PQPlatform, PQPerform, PQCryptoLib, and PQMicroLib with partner technology into solutions customers can adopt quickly.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop the semiconductor ecosystem: Build and manage relationships with semiconductor suppliers, foundries, EDA and IP partners, processor and security-subsystem providers, and design services firms. Make PQShield IP the default choice for PQC in their roadmaps, reference designs, and platforms.</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive partnerships that create demand: Identify, structure, and launch technical partnerships that open new markets and channels. relationships to build the brand: Leverage your network across semiconductors, security, and system OEMs to establish PQShield as the key technology and brand for post-quantum security.</p> </li> <li> multi-stakeholder deals with engineers, architects, and executives.</p> </li> <li> <p>Shape the market narrative: Define how the industry thinks about the post-quantum transition, cryptographic agility, side-channel and fault-injection protection, and certification (FIPS 140-3, SESIP, Common Criteria, ISO 26262) — and where PQShield fits.</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead technical launches: Plan and deliver the technical go-to-market for new products, certifications, reference designs, and partner integrations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bring the market back in: Feed customer, partner, and competitive PQShield reference designs on widely used MCUs or SoCs, built with silicon partners and used in active sales opportunities.</p> </li> <li> <p>Semiconductor ecosystem: Sign 5 ecosystem partners, such requirements: Run 10 joint roadmap meetings that bring together an OEM, its silicon supplier and PQShield, and secure 5 OEM letters or RFQs that ask silicon suppliers for PQC capability.</p> </li> <li> <p>Partner-sourced pipeline: Create identifiable silicon pipeline from ecosystem partners and joint roadmap meetings, tagged as influenced in CRM, that contributes to the company goals of 3x PQShield in at least one standards or industry working group.</p> </li> <li> <p>Market insight: Deliver a quarterly report to product and engineering on partner, customer and competitive requirements.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We're looking for a senior technical marketing leader with a security IP background, a strong industry network, and a track record of turning partnerships and technical credibility into revenue.</p> <ul> <li> <p>12+ years in semiconductor IP, security, or embedded technology, with at least 5 years in technical marketing, solutions, business development, or ecosystem leadership roles.</p> </li> <li> <p>A background in security IP — for example, hardware security modules, root of trust, secure enclaves, cryptographic accelerators, or embedded security software.</p> </li> <li> <p>Established relationships across semiconductor suppliers, IP and EDA vendors, system OEMs, and the security industry that you can use to open doors and build PQShield's position.</p> </li> <li> <p>A proven record of building ecosystem programs and partnerships that measurably grew pipeline and revenue.</p> </li> <li> <p>Credibility as a technical thought leader: experience speaking at industry events, writing for technical audiences, and engaging analysts, press, and   • Strong debugging skills, including the ability to investigate issues spanning RTL, models, clocks, resets, configuration, and analog behavior.

  • Experience with scripting and automation, preferably Python, Tcl, shell, or similar.

  • Build and maintain verification environments at block, subsystem, and SoC level.

  • Develop tests, assertions, checkers, scoreboards, and functional coverage.

  • Verify digital control and configuration of analog/mixed-signal circuitry across normal operation, corner cases, and error conditions.

  • Run regressions, analyze coverage, debug failures, and drive verification to sign-off.

  • Develop or integrate behavioral and real-number models needed for efficient mixed-signal simulation.

  • Work closely with analog, RTL, architecture, firmware, and SoC verification teams to identify and resolve interface issues.

  • Experience with SoC-level integration and verification of complex interface IP.

  • Experience with low-power verification, power-state management, or UPF.

  • Experience driving a complex IP or SoC verification effort through coverage closure and tape-out.

title: Lead Product Manager - AI Platform
description: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it. Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us! 📱 Our Product Team Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams. Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value: Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team. Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app. Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell. AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability. ⚡ The AI Platform tribe AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI. Its flagship product is Joker , Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates. For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham , the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable. The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years. 🎯 What you will do As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows. Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job. Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope. Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment. Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day. Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt. Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction. Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. raw.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

📱 Our Product Team

Led by Fabien, our VP Product, Joko's Product team groups the passionate individuals behind our users' delight! From brainstorming to development to launch, the Product team's main mission is to turn ideas into reality by working hand-in-hand with the Engineering, Design, and Business teams.

Joko is organized into four product tribes, each owning a key dimension of the company's value:

  • Business lines owns the current core value proposition, covering online shopping, in-store experiences, and gift cards, each run as a dedicated team.

  • Scale focuses on growing and amplifying this value through growth, international expansion, and shared core user experiences across the app.

  • Juno builds the next value proposition: an AI shopping assistant that finds the right product at the best price in seconds, backed by a universal catalog of what merchants actually sell.

  • AI Platform helps Joko become a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside, owning the internal agent infrastructure, automation layer, internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security and operational scalability.

⚡ The AI Platform tribe

AI Platform's mission is to turn Joko into a state-of-the-art AI company from the inside. The tribe builds the internal agent infrastructure that will let every team work faster, automate complex workflows, and create new 0-to-1 features with AI.

Its flagship product is Joker, Joko's internal AI teammate. Already live in Slack, Notion and Linear, Joker can understand context, use tools, act across systems, and take real work from idea to execution. The ambition is not just to automate repetitive tasks, but to make agents a new production layer for how Joko builds and operates.

For this to work at company scale, AI Platform also owns the backbone underneath: Gotham, the identity and permission layer that lets agents act with exactly the access of the person they work for; plus the internal tools, infrastructure, compliance, security, reliability and server-cost foundations that keep Joko fast, safe and scalable.

The tribe's users are the teams inside Joko. Its goal is simple: help them run extremely efficient processes, remove operational bottlenecks, and give the company the leverage it needs to scale in the coming years.

🎯 What you will do

As Lead Product Manager for the Platform tribe, your mission is to make Joko's own machine faster, safer and increasingly agentic. You will report to Fabien, our VP Product, own the tribe's roadmap end to end, and lead the Product Managers on its task forces as the team grows. The tribe is being staffed right now, so expect to be hands-on from day one on scopes you own personally, and to build the function as the team grows.

  • Set the tribe's strategy: You will decide what Platform builds, in what order, and what it stops doing. You will map what teams across the company do today in our internal tools, what it costs them and what they need next, then turn that into a roadmap you can defend in front of leadership. This intake runs permanently, as a standing part of the job.

  • Own Joker and Gotham: These are the tribe's most strategic bets and you will drive them personally. Taking Joker from what it is today to a production-grade agent platform, and shipping Gotham's permission model so agents never hold more access than the person they act for, is the highest-leverage work in your scope.

  • Build the automation layer: The approach is capability first: expose an action as a scoped tool, write the instructions an agent needs to use it well, then let the agent run the job. Interfaces come only where they earn their place, and deciding what still deserves a screen is a genuinely new kind of product judgment.

  • Retire what should not exist: Part of the mandate is subtractive: migrating off tools that have outlived their purpose and progressively switching off legacy systems, without breaking the teams that depend on them every day.

  • Own security, compliance and reliability: Identity and access, data retention and minimization, log centralization, audit, test coverage. The requirement often comes from Legal or an auditor, and still has to be shaped into something people will actually adopt.

  • Lead and grow the team: You will hire, mentor and lead the Product Managers who own the tribe's task forces, set the bar on discovery and delivery, and be the person the tribe's engineers and designers look to for product direction.

  • Be the interface for the whole company: You will be the point of contact for Engineering, Ops, Finance, Legal, Data and Care, structuring their demands and arbitrating between them. You will define success in time saved, cost removed, risk reduced and adoption by internal teams, and report on it in those terms.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 5+ years of experience in Product, including experience leading or mentoring other Product Managers. A background on internal tools, back-office products, APIs, platforms or complex B2B products is a strong plus.

  • AI fluency, hands-on: This scope is being rebuilt around agents, so this criterion carries the most weight. You use AI tools daily in your own work, you understand what agents are actually good and bad at, and you have opinions about where automation belongs and where a human interface still earns its place.

  • Product for teams mindset: You are comfortable building for internal users, where the bar is efficiency, robustness and adoption rather than polish. Problems nobody outside the company will ever see still energise you. If what drives you is craft on a consumer surface seen by millions, this scope will frustrate you.

  • Strong technical appetite: You are curious and hands-on with infrastructure, identity, permissions, reliability, security, compliance and data architecture. Coding is not required, but you need to understand how things work.

  • Management: You have a proven track record in people management. You know how to grow Product Managers, set a high bar for rigor, and give direction without taking every decision yourself.

  • Stakeholder leadership: You are excellent at alignment, prioritization and saying no. You can navigate many dependencies, arbitrate between senior stakeholders, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Analytical & pragmatic: You are data-driven, impact-oriented, and you go straight for the real operational problem.

  • Communication: You are a clear, structured communicator, able to translate complex technical topics into business impact for the exec team.

  • Location: Based in France or Spain.

  • Languages: Fluent in English, both written and spoken. French is a plus, but it is optional.

  • Mindset: You are ownership-driven, resilient, and motivated by solving hard, unglamorous but high-impact problems that make the whole company better. You have an entrepreneurial mindset, you like challenges, you welcome feedback and you love constantly learning and getting better.

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €78.3K – €125.9K

raw.title: Workplace Manager
raw.description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko.

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US.

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🌱 Our People Team

At Joko, we believe that our people are our strongest asset, and the People Team is one of the core pillars of the company. We span Talent Acquisition, People Operations, People Business Partnering, and Workplace, and we work hand in hand with every team to make Joko efficient, scalable, and a place people genuinely love working at. We don't just run people processes — we design, challenge, and rethink them.

Today, Joko is 100+ people across Paris, Barcelona, and New York, and we are set to grow to 200+ within 18 months. That kind of growth only holds up if the office, the rituals, and the daily fabric of the company scale with it — which is where the Workplace Manager comes in.

🎯 What you will do

As Workplace Manager, your mission is to make Joko a place people genuinely love coming to every day, and to hold our culture together as we double in size. You will report to the VP People and partner closely with the rest of the People team, Finance, and Legal.

  • Own the Paris office end-to-end: Our Paris office is your canvas. You will manage service providers, supplies, and facilities, keep the space impeccable and organized, and be the first point of contact for anything office-related. You will also be the go-to resource for our remote teammates across France and abroad, so the experience of working at Joko feels consistent regardless of where people sit.

  • Bring the team together through events: From All Hands to Joko Academies, Team Events, Joko Drinks, offsites, and our legendary Christmas Party, you will design and run each gathering so it is not just well-organized, but a genuine moment of connection. As we grow into an international company, you will make sure our rituals scale with us and keep bringing the team together across geographies.

  • Own onboarding end-to-end: First impressions matter, and onboarding is one of the most consequential parts of the Joko experience. You will run the process from employment contract to IT setup to team introductions to custom Joko goodies, so every new hire lands seamlessly and feels welcome from day one.

  • Hold the culture as we scale: Doubling in size is precisely when a company culture can slip. The office you run, the events you design, and the way new joiners are welcomed are where Joko's culture gets rebuilt every day. You will be one of the people who keeps Joko Joko as we grow.

  • Keep admin and compliance airtight: You will track expenses, make sure invoices are recorded correctly for our accounting team, and partner with Finance and Legal on our compliance routines so nothing falls through the cracks.

👀 Who we're looking for

  • Experience: You have 3+ years in Workplace, Office Management, People Operations, Event Management, or a similar role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company. You have already owned an office and a set of team rituals end-to-end — you know what it takes to make them impeccable, not just functional.

  • Ownership mindset: You take full ownership of your scope, from strategy down to the smallest detail, and run complex projects from start to finish with little supervision.

  • Attention to detail: You spot what others miss. A crooked frame, a missing supply, a rough onboarding email — none of it gets past you, because you know these details are what people actually feel.

  • Organized and efficient: You are structured, calm under pressure, and excellent at juggling many priorities without dropping any of them. You care about deadlines and you meet them.

  • Interpersonal skills: You build strong relationships across the team and foster a real sense of belonging. People feel comfortable coming to you, and you make them feel taken care of.

  • Confident communicator: You are comfortable engaging with the team every day and speaking in front of large groups when the moment calls for it.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. You welcome feedback, you go the extra mile by default, and you are not afraid of taking initiative on topics that were not in your job description.

  • Location: Based in Paris.

  • Languages: You are fluent in French and English (our working language).

💎 Our perks

(Some of the benefits listed below are available to full-time positions only)

At Joko, we believe that flexibility and trust are essential. Our work environment reflects this through:

  • Flexible remote : If you live in Paris, you can choose to work from our office or from home with no constraints. If you live elsewhere, we can provide access to a coworking space and a coworking budget.

  • Work from anywhere : Want to spend a month in Italy while working? You can work from most countries in the world for up to 3 months per year.

On top of that, we offer plenty of perks:

  • 💸 Top-market compensation

  • 📈 Equity for everyone with the chance to own a piece of what you build

  • 🤖 Half-day each week dedicated to leveling up with AI by exploring new tools, iterating hard, and sharpening your skills

  • 🌴 Yearly offsite in amazing locations and budget for team-building events & monthly in-person gatherings

  • 💪 Contribution to your ClassPass subscription

  • 🍼 8-week leave paid 100% for the second parent

  • …and much more, check the full list here!

🤝 Our hiring process

  1. Intro call: Quick screening with the Hiring Manager or the Talent team.

  2. Step 1 – Team interview (45 min): Conversation with two Joko team members (could include the Hiring Manager, people from the team you’d join, or colleagues from other teams).

  3. Step 2 – Role-specific assessments

    • For non-engineering roles: A take-home case study followed by a 45-min interview. We assess both your output and how you think in real time. The exercise will be relevant to your role (e.g. analysis, strategy, or process design).

    • For engineering roles: A 90-min live technical interview on CoderPad covering code understanding, review, system design, and product thinking (with AI serving as a collaboration tool).

  4. Step 3 – Leadership interview (45 min): Conversation with a SteerCo member and a Founder.

  5. References: Up to 3 calls with former colleagues or managers.

☕ You may also be invited for coffee with team members to get a feel for our culture.

Compensation: €42K – €59K • Offers Equity

title: Senior DevOps / SRE – Lead Infrastructure
description: ILLUIN Technology est le leader français de l'IA Générative souveraine, du traitement documentaire intelligent ( Illuin Doc Automation ) et des solutions de conversation automatisée ( Illuin Dialogue ). Nous développons des modèles de langage (LLM) propriétaires et une plateforme technologique de pointe pour permettre aux entreprises et aux grandes organisations de déployer l'IA en toute sécurité, en gardant la maîtrise absolue de leurs données et infrastructures. Dans le cadre du passage à l'échelle de nos offres SaaS et de l'accompagnement d'architectures sur-mesure chez nos clients, nous recrutons un(e) Senior DevOps / SRE Engineer chevronné(e) pour piloter nos enjeux d'infrastructure, de Run et de consulting. → Votre mission En tant que Senior DevOps & SRE / Lead Infrastructure , vous occupez un rôle pivot à la croisée de l'ingénierie produit, de la gestion du Run et du conseil d'expertise technique : Proximité Produit : Vous travaillez en lien direct et étroit avec les équipes produits (Lead Engineers, Software Architects, R&D) pour industrialiser, déployer et faire évoluer la suite logicielle ILLUIN. Run SaaS (SRE) : Vous êtes le/la garant(e) de la haute disponibilité, de la sécurité et de la scalabilité de l'ensemble de nos services hébergés en SaaS. Consulting Client : Vous intervenez directement auprès de nos clients grands comptes dans le cadre de missions d'expertise et de conseil (prestations facturées) pour concevoir et paramétrer des architectures Cloud/MLOps adaptées à leurs environnements complexes. → Vos responsabilités 🚀 1. Industrialisation & déploiement des produits ILLUIN Industrialiser, automatiser et standardiser le déploiement et le packaging des produits ILLUIN : Doc Automation, Dialogue, nAIxt et briques LLM/NLP . Définir et faire évoluer les stratégies de déploiement : SaaS, On-Premise, Cloud souverain et environnements hybrides . Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Software Engineering et R&D afin d'intégrer les exigences d'exploitabilité dès la conception. Définir et faire évoluer les bonnes pratiques de CI/CD, GitOps et Infrastructure-as-Code . Identifier et piloter des chantiers d'amélioration des pratiques Ops. ☁️ 2. Cloud & Infrastructure Concevoir, déployer et maintenir des infrastructures Cloud via Terraform et/ou Pulumi . Travailler sur des environnements AWS, GCP, Azure et OVHcloud . Administrer et faire évoluer des clusters Kubernetes , ainsi que les problématiques de réseau, stockage, sécurité et haute disponibilité. Participer à la conception d'architectures Cloud, On-Premise et hybrides adaptées aux contraintes techniques et de sécurité de nos clients. Contribuer à la mise en œuvre d'infrastructures répondant aux exigences de sécurité, RGPD et souveraineté des données . ⚡ 3. SRE & Run Garantir la disponibilité, la performance et la résilience des plateformes SaaS. Participer au Maintien en Condition Opérationnelle (MCO) et à l'amélioration continue des environnements de production. Mettre en place et faire évoluer les pratiques d' observabilité : métriques, logs, alerting et monitoring. Travailler notamment avec des outils tels que Prometheus, Grafana, ELK ou Datadog . Participer à la gestion des incidents critiques, aux analyses post-mortem et à la mise en œuvre d'actions correctives. Contribuer à la définition et au respect des SLA et des standards de fiabilité. 🤝 4. Expertise technique & accompagnement client Intervenir ponctuellement auprès de clients grands comptes sur des problématiques Cloud, SRE et infrastructure. Analyser leurs environnements et contraintes afin de proposer des architectures adaptées. Accompagner les équipes techniques clientes dans le déploiement, le paramétrage et l'adoption des solutions ILLUIN. Apporter votre expertise technique lors des phases de cadrage et d'avant-vente , notamment dans le cadre de réponses à des appels d'offres. Être capable de vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques. Profil recherché 🛠️ Compétences techniques 5 ans d'expérience minimum dans des fonctions DevOps, SRE, Cloud, Platform Engineering ou Architecture Infrastructure. Solide maîtrise de Kubernetes et des environnements conteneurisés. Très bonne maîtrise de l' Infrastructure-as-Code , notamment Terraform et/ou Pulumi. Expérience significative sur un ou plusieurs Cloud Providers majeurs : AWS, GCP, Azure, OVHcloud . Bonne maîtrise des pratiques CI/CD, GitOps et automatisation . Expérience des problématiques de production, haute disponibilité, observabilité et incident management . Connaissance d'outils de monitoring et observabilité tels que Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog ou ELK . Bonne compréhension des architectures distribuées et des environnements microservices. Des connaissances en Python, Java ou Node.js sont appréciées pour comprendre et accompagner les environnements applicatifs. Une sensibilité aux problématiques IA, LLM, MLOps/LLMOps et Vector Databases est un plus. 🧠 Soft skills Esprit Maker & Hands-on : vous aimez comprendre, construire, tester et améliorer. Leadership technique : vous êtes capable de prendre ownership d'un sujet et de faire avancer les décisions techniques. Pédagogie : vous savez expliquer et vulgariser des problématiques d'infrastructure complexes. Posture conseil & sens client : vous êtes à l'aise avec des interlocuteurs techniques et métiers chez nos clients. Autonomie et rigueur : vous savez prioriser, structurer vos actions et aller au bout des sujets. Esprit d'équipe : vous appréciez travailler avec des profils variés au sein d'une organisation à taille intermédiaire. Wir unterstützen namhafte Immobilien- und Industriekunden bei der Analyse, Finanzierung, Umsetzung und kontinuierlichen Optimierung nachhaltiger Energielösungen. Mit unserer digitalen Plattform ermöglichen wir unseren Kunden, die Wirtschaftlichkeit und CO₂-Bilanz ihrer Immobilien zu verbessern und gleichzeitig technische, kommerzielle und energetische Risiken zu minimieren.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Operations-Teams suchen wir eine/n Projektmanager/in Energy Systems, der/die Energieprojekte technologieübergreifend verantwortet und gemeinsam mit unseren Installationspartnern für eine reibungslose und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung sorgt. Du bist die treibende Kraft hinter deinen Projekten: Du definierst frühzeitig die zentralen technischen Parameter – vom Standort über den Anschlusspunkt bis zur Komponentenwahl – und steuerst deine Projekte von der Machbarkeitsstudie über Bewilligung und Planung bis hin zur Inbetriebnahme.

Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns eine nachhaltige und wirtschaftliche Energieversorgung.

Tasks

  • Eigenverantwortliche Leitung von Projekten im Bereich Energy Systems, je nach Projekt in den Bereichen Wärme, Solar und Batterie
  • Erstellung von Machbarkeitsstudien und technischen Konzepten sowie Bewertung von Varianten in technischer und wirtschaftlicher Hinsicht
  • Einholen, kritische Prüfung und Vergabe von Angeboten bei Installationspartnern
  • Steuerung von Baubewilligungen, technischen Anschlussgesuchen und Ausführungsplanung
  • Koordination der Umsetzung vor Ort, Kontrolle von Qualität und Terminen sowie souveräner Umgang mit unvorhergesehenen Situationen
  • Betreuung der beteiligten Anspruchsgruppen, von der Hausverwaltung über die Bewohnerschaft bis zum Kunden, mit klarer und proaktiver Kommunikation
  • Sicherstellung sauberer Daten in unseren Systemen, vollständiger Dokumentation und einer reibungslosen Übergabe

Requirements

  • Technische Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Energie-, Gebäude-, Maschinen- oder Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Erfahrung im technischen Projektmanagement, idealerweise im Umfeld erneuerbarer Energien oder der Gebäudetechnik
  • Technisches Verständnis kombiniert mit kommerziellem Denken in Budget, Kosten und Terminen
  • Sicherheit in der Koordination von Partnern und Anspruchsgruppen sowie in der zuverlässigen Umsetzung von Projekten
  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Wärmepumpen und Heizungssysteme sind von Vorteil, entscheidend ist ein echtes Interesse, dich in diesem Feld zu vertiefen
  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, Französisch- oder Italienischkenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Strukturierte und proaktive Arbeitsweise mit ausgeprägtem Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld

Benefits

  • Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket und spannende Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Weiterbildungen im Bereich erneuerbare Energien und Projektmanagement
  • Ein dynamisches, innovatives Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und viel Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Die Möglichkeit, aktiv an der Energiewende mitzuwirken und echten Impact zu schaffen

description: Join the Wingtra team and become part of this venture-backed robotics scaleup with a global and international team of 125+ dedicated Wingtranauts who want to see their actions have a positive and lasting impact on the world. Founded more than 8 years ago at ETH Zurich, Europe’s leading robotics university, our goal is to build the best aerial robots to digitize the world at the push of a button and set the basis for faster and better decisions. Wingtra provides efficient and reliable data solutions to a variety of industries ranging from mining, construction and agriculture to humanitarian organizations, environmentalists and wildlife monitoring groups. We are reaching for the stars and together we might just get there. Open communication, asking hard questions and valuing diverse viewpoints are but a few things that will help us achieve our goals. Above all we will never stop learning and striving to help each other reach our maximum potential. Wingtra builds professional drones that help people map and understand the world. Join the team creating our next aircraft and the tools that build and test it. You’ll be a hands-on generalist who combines mechatronic design and system integration. You’ll work for drone operators and for our colleagues on the production floor. We’re early adopters of AI and build agents into everyday engineering. We want you to keep expanding what we can design, build and test. Responsibilities Design what flies and what attaches to it. You design, integrate and qualify mechanical and mechatronic assemblies for the drone and its accessories. That covers mounts and interfaces, plus sensors and actuators working together. You team up with our electronics designers and suppliers to get designs that can be manufactured. Build the rigs that prove it. You develop qualification rigs and production QC setups. You design fixtures and adapters in CAD, integrate PCBAs and instruments and wire sensors and actuators. Then you bring up the whole system, debug and iterate it until it’s reliable. Automate the checks. You integrate a Raspberry Pi and write Python tools for flashing, calibration and end-of-line checks. You build the operator interface with serial-number traceability and robust data pipeline. Make every test mean something. You design for testability. You use requirements and FMEA to define tests and to justify pass/fail limits. You validate measurement accuracy and repeatability, diagnose faults and improve production yield. Take it to the line. You commission QC stations with the Production Engineers on shared infrastructure. You support their takeover and resolve issues through ramp-up. You leave behind tools and documentation they can maintain. Requirements You have depth in one engineering discipline. You’ve also integrated mechanics, electronics and software into systems that work. We value complementary strengths and practical ownership across disciplines. You enjoy product design and test engineering alike. Building tools that make your colleagues on the production floor faster and happier is part of the fun. AI agents already help you learn, design, code and analyze. You check what they produce, invent better workflows and share what works with the team. You prototype fast, debug systematically and keep going until something is reliable enough for someone else to use. You’ll sit in the Engineering team with real ownership, from the first concept to a working production line. You’re based in Zurich. During commissioning and ramp-up, you’ll spend time with our production partners in Europe and the USA. If you enjoy teamwork more than being the individual superhero, and if you thrive in a feedback-driven culture and an exciting, unconventional yet structured and progressive start-up environment, we would love to hear from you. Wat ga je doen

Als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder ben jij een belangrijke schakel tussen gebruikers, de business, IT-teams en leveranciers. title: Senior Recruiter
description: Bouw jij vandaag al aan het talent dat Athora morgen nodig heeft? Dan maken we graag kennis met je! Wat je over ons moet weten? Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat. Wat ga je doen? Recruitment bij Athora gaat verder dan het invullen van vacatures en interim opdrachten. We willen vooruitkijken: welke kennis, expertise en talenten hebben we nu en in de toekomst nodig en hoe zorgen we dat we deze tijdig aan ons binden? Wij helpen managers hun future fit teams bouwen. Als Senior Recruiter combineer je strategisch recruitmentadvies met sterke operationele executie. Je bent gesprekspartner voor management en HR Business Partners, kent de arbeidsmarkt en brengt een eigen visie mee. Tegelijkertijd sta je midden in de dagelijkse recruitmentdynamiek. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen managers, HR Business Partners en kandidaten en zorgt ervoor dat ieder recruitmentproces soepel, zorgvuldig en persoonlijk verloopt. Je hebt een sleutelrol in het aantrekken van het talent dat Athora nodig heeft om haar ambities voor vandaag én morgen te realiseren. Je verdiept je in wat er binnen de organisatie speelt, begrijpt de uitdagingen van verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen en vertaalt deze ontwikkelingen naar recruitmentoplossingen. Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden zijn: Je bent regisseur van het recruitmentproces. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen kandidaten, hiring managers en HR Business Partners en zorgt voor een professioneel én persoonlijk proces, van intake en werving tot selectie, aanbieding en onboarding. Je houdt tempo, stuurt actief op voortgang en zorgt dat afspraken en contacten zorgvuldig worden vastgelegd. Je ondersteunt bij externe inhuur. Je adviseert managers over passende inzet, onderhandelt over tarief, duur en andere voorwaarden en draagt zorg voor een zorgvuldig proces en goede vastlegging. Je brengt Recruitment verder als strategische gesprekspartner. Je vertaalt ontwikkelingen in de organisatie en op de arbeidsmarkt naar een heldere recruitmentaanpak en adviseert managers en HR Business Partners proactief over de personeelsbehoefte van vandaag én morgen. Je maakt data leidend in recruitmentadvies en besluitvorming. Je ontwikkelt samen met het team onze visie op AI binnen Recruitment. Je onderzoekt waar AI het recruitmentproces slimmer en effectiever kan maken en helpt bepalen waar technologie waarde toevoegt én waar persoonlijk contact het verschil moet blijven maken. Je benut recruitment- en arbeidsmarktdata om trends, knelpunten en kansen zichtbaar te maken, vertaalt deze naar impactvolle inzichten en gebruikt de data om gericht te adviseren en bij te sturen op onder andere instroom, doorlooptijd, kwaliteit en inzet van recruitmentkanalen. Je bouwt mee aan de verdere professionalisering van Recruitment. Je draagt bij aan de ontwikkeling van onze recruitmentstrategie, employer branding en kandidaat propositie. Je vertaalt nieuwe ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in werkwijze, processen en dienstverlening. Wat vragen we van jou? Je bent een stevige en verbindende recruitmentprofessional die gemakkelijk schakelt tussen strategie en uitvoering. Je bent nieuwsgierig en resultaatgericht. Je bent een gelijkwaardige gesprekspartner voor (senior) management en HR, je durft vanuit je expertise te adviseren en te challengen. Je stelt de juiste vragen en neemt een vacatureaanvraag niet automatisch voor gegeven aan. Je wil eerst begrijpen: wat is hier werkelijk nodig? Je weet mensen mee te krijgen in je aanpak. Tegelijkertijd houd je oog voor wat er in de dagelijkse recruitmentpraktijk nodig is en zorg je ervoor dat afspraken en processen zorgvuldig worden opgevolgd. Daarnaast: heb je hbo+/wo werk- en denkniveau en minimaal 7 jaar relevante ervaring in corporate recruitment; werk je graag met data en AI en vertaalt inzichten naar concrete adviezen en acties; werk je gestructureerd en accuraat en weet je hoe belangrijk goede vastlegging is voor een professioneel recruitmentproces en goede samenwerking binnen het team; kun je overzicht houden over meerdere processen tegelijkertijd zonder de persoonlijke aandacht voor kandidaten en managers te verliezen; heb je ervaring binnen financial services of een andere kennisintensieve en gereguleerde omgeving een pré; beheers je zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift. Wat krijg je van ons? Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag. Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op ons kantoor in Amsterdam dat behoort tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar. En omdat je ook regelmatig thuis zult werken, ontvang je een budget om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten. In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris plus een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, krijg je een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten. Salaris per maand: Op basis van cao schaal 15 HAY (incl. CAO verhoging per 1 Januari 2027) is de range € 4.435,55 tot € 5.913,69 op basis van 36 uur. Enthousiast? Coda is a global growth engine for commerce, connecting people, digital products, and payments through trusted monetization and distribution solutions.

Our culture is built on respect, ownership, and collaboration. We move fast, support each other, and celebrate wins together.

If you’re looking to grow your career and make a real impact in a global team, Coda is the place for you. 


The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Legal Counsel to join our close-knit commercial Legal team at Coda in Amsterdam, supporting a fast-growing business across fintech, payments, ecommerce and digital platforms.

This is an exciting opportunity to develop your skills and gain valuable experience in a truly international, digital-first company. You'll work in a dynamic, collaborative environment, with exposure to both our European businesses and the wider global Coda group.

The role is ideal for a commercially minded, proactive lawyer who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, applying legal expertise creatively and pragmatically to support business growth.

You will report to the Lead Counsel, Europe, who is based in India, and work closely with our global legal team and stakeholders across the company.


What You'll Do

  • Provide end-to-end legal support to Coda’s European businesses, advising on commercial contracts, product-related matters, corporate issues and general legal queries

  • Draft, review and negotiate a wide range of customer, partner, vendor and technology agreements, providing pragmatic advice on deal structuring, risk allocation and regulatory requirements

  • Act as a trusted legal partner to Product, Commercial, Engineering and Operations teams, supporting product launches, new features and go-to-market initiatives

  • Take ownership of key legal matters and projects, working independently and proactively while balancing commercial priorities and legal risks

  • Support strategic initiatives, including M&A projects, disputes, European regulatory matters and cross-border projects involving Coda’s global businesses

  • Collaborate with global legal, compliance, corporate secretarial, investigations and regulatory teams to ensure effective and consistent legal support across Europe

  • Contribute to the development of legal processes, templates and playbooks to support the business's continued growth and international expansion

  • Work closely with senior business stakeholders and the Lead Counsel, Europe, acting as a key legal point of contact for European matters and ensuring alignment on priorities and risks


What You'll Have

  • A Dutch-qualified lawyer with a Master’s degree in Law, preferably from a Dutch university, and at least 7 years of relevant experience in commercial or corporate law, ideally gained in-house or at a leading law firm

  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating complex commercial contracts, with sound commercial judgement and a pragmatic, business-focused approach to managing legal risk

title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
description: <p>Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning.&nbsp;</p> <p>Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge.</p> <p>Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success.</p> <h1>Your responsibilities will include:</h1> <ul> <li>Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning.</li> <li>Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system.</li> <li>Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization.</li> <li>Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking.</li> <li>Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda.</li> <li>Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture.</li> </ul> <h1>We expect you to have:</h1> <ul> <li>A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead.</li> <li>At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI.</li> <li>A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with:</li> <ul> <li>Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation.</li> <li>Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent.</li> <li>Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.</li> <li>Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models.</li> </ul> <li>Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.</li> <li>Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h1>Our ideal candidate would have:</h1> <ul> <li>Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning.</li> <li>Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase.</li> <li>The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation.</li> <li>A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research.</li> <li>Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows.</li> <li>Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications.</li> </ul> <h1>What we offer</h1> <ul> <li>A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits.</li> <li>A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy.</li> </ul> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-KP1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>We are an equal opportunity As a Senior UX Designer on the Map Visualisation team, you will shape how our 2D and 3D geospatial data is designed, styled and delivered across TomTom's product portfolio.   You'll spend your days crafting multi-zoom map experiences, working with spatial data and collaborating closely with engineers and product managers to turn cartographic intent into production-ready map styles. You'll need to be as comfortable discussing label collision and style-layer specifications with engineers as you are refining colour palettes and visual hierarchy.   This is a product role first. You'll be embedded in a cross-functional team that ships map rendering, map styles and SDKs used by other TomTom products and by the customers who build on our platform. You'll take part in the whole development lifecycle, from discovery and solution design through pull requests to release. Your product judgement, and your ability to bring people with competing priorities to a clear decision, matter here as much as your cartographic craft.   AI is part of how we work. We expect you to use it to explore, prototype and ship faster, to know where it falls short, and to help shape map experiences in products where AI is part of the experience itself.   What You'll Do Design Compelling Map Experiences Create and refine 2D and 3D map visualisations from concept through production delivery. Own the end-to-end cartographic design process - from data exploration and sketching through to style implementation, QA and iteration across zoom levels, regions and use cases.   Maintain and Evolve Core Map Styles Enhance TomTom's core map styles, ensuring consistency, readability and visual quality across platforms, screen densities and global markets. Balance aesthetic ambition with rendering performance and data constraints.   Work as Part of the Product Team Work day-to-day alongside software engineers and product managers building TomTom's map data structures, renderers and SDKs. Take part in planning, refinement and reviews, provide design specifications engineers can act on, and review visual output during development and before release.   Make and Own Trade-offs Help decide what ships, when and at what quality. Weigh visual fidelity against render budget, memory and frame rate on automotive and mobile hardware, customer requests against platform consistency, and scope against release dates. Reach a decision with the people who own the product, record it and see it through.   Contribute to Renderer and Tooling Requirements Provide detailed input on the data and rendering capabilities needed to achieve design goals. Define requirements for internal cartographic authoring tools and identify workflow improvements that raise the team's output quality and speed.   Bring AI into the Design Workflow Use AI to shorten the loop from idea to rendered map: generating and editing style-spec JSON, scripting data exploration, and building interactive prototypes on real data instead of static frames. Turn what works into shared workflows the team can reuse, and help define how we check AI-generated output for cartographic quality.   Design for AI-Driven Map Experiences Contribute to how the map responds when the request comes from an AI system rather than a tap, for example in GeoAI answers, conversational search or agent-generated routes. Work out how the map shows what the AI found, how confident it is and when it is wrong.   Inform Decisions with Research and Data Participate in user research, customer conversations and competitive benchmarking. Use insights to ground design decisions and advocate for improvements that address real user needs.   Support the Design System and Standards Contribute to the Map Visualisation design system - documenting patterns, conventions and cartographic guidelines that enable consistency and scale across the product portfolio.   What You'll Need Leadership & Product Team Experience   A track record of shaping product direction from the design seat. You set out the options, make the case for one and bring engineering, product and business stakeholders with you.   A track record of shipping software as a designer embedded in a product team, ideally on map, location or developer-platform products: SDKs, APIs, map styles or tooling that other teams and companies build on.   A clear understanding of how products move from discovery to release and beyond, including planning, roadmaps and measuring results after launch. You know how versioned releases, deprecations and backwards compatibility shape design choices on a platform with external customers.   Hands-on familiarity with how software gets built: backlogs, refinement, estimation, definition of done, Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD, feature flags and release trains. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand how your designs move through a rendering pipeline and into a release.   Sound judgement under constraint. You can point to decisions where you gave something up to ship, and explain why it was right for the product and its users.   Clarity with senior audiences. You can turn a complex design problem into a short, well-argued recommendation and own the result.   Comfort with disagreement. You challenge a decision with evidence, accept the outcome when it goes the other way and keep the work moving.   Experience contributing to solution design documents, technical specifications and cross-functional planning.   Cartography & Digital Map Making   A solid foundation in digital cartography, GIS or geographic information design. If your map-making depth is still growing, show us how fast you are closing the gap, including how you use AI to learn.   Experience designing multi-zoom digital maps with attention to cartographic conventions, label placement, generalisation and cultural adaptation.   Working proficiency with key mapping technologies and ecosystems: MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS, OpenStreetMap data and tooling, QGIS, ArcGIS, Leaflet, OpenLayers or comparable platforms.   Experience working with diverse spatial datasets - vector tiles, raster tiles, GeoJSON, shapefiles, point clouds or terrain data.   Awareness of cartographic standards across regions and cultures, including sensitive topics such as disputed borders and local place names.   Map Visualisation & Rendering   Demonstrated ability to build visually compelling 2D and 3D map experiences - from thematic styling and terrain visualisation to street-level detail.   Hands-on experience designing 3D map content such as buildings, terrain, landmarks and lane-level road geometry, in stylised or realistic form. You understand how LOD, lighting, materials and camera pitch affect legibility and performance.   Experience with 3D data formats and pipelines such as glTF and 3D Tiles, and how 3D assets are prepared and optimised for real-time map rendering.   Good understanding of real-time rendering concepts as they apply to maps: style layers, zoom interpolation, data-driven styling, symbol rendering and performance considerations.   AI in Your Practice   Evidence that AI has changed how you work. Be ready to show a real example, such as a map style, data visualisation or coded prototype built with AI, and tell us where it let you down.   Sharp judgement of AI output. You can spot errors in generated work and know which decisions still need a designer's eye.   Experience turning personal AI use into workflows the team shares, within the limits of confidential data and licensing.   Senior-Level Craft & Collaboration   5+ years of professional experience in UX, product or cartographic design, with most of that time spent inside software product teams.   Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cartography, Geography, GIS, UX Design, Computer Science or a related field - or equivalent professional experience.   Ability to build clear, concise prototypes and specification documentation that bridge design and engineering.   Strong visual and graphic design fundamentals - typography, colour theory, hierarchy and layout.   User-centric mindset with a collaborative, low-ego approach to problem-solving.   High attention to detail and a real passion for the craft of map making.   Nice to Have Experience with game engines or 3D content pipelines (Unity, Unreal Engine, Blender) and their application to geospatial visualisation.   Familiarity with front-end languages and graphics APIs (JavaScript/TypeScript, WebGL, WebGPU, GLSL) or scripting for cartographic automation (Python, PostGIS, Overpass API). With AI, even basic coding skills go a long way.   Experience with map data processing tools and pipelines: Tippecanoe, Tilemaker, osm2pgsql, Mapnik or similar.   Understanding of the automotive, fleet management or logistics industries and their mapping requirements.   Familiarity with emerging trends in spatial computing, AR navigation or digital twins.   Experience contributing to design systems at scale.   What we offer A competitive compensation package, of course.   Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.  Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.   Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize.
